free_tier.stated: Prepaid Upload-GB: 50 GB upload $1.20, 100 GB $1.60, 500 GB $3.99, 1000×n GB $6.99×n. 1 Upload-GB = a 1 GB file kept available for 7 days.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: 1 Upload-GB = a 1 GB file kept available for 7 days

egress.terms: Downloads are gated per-file, not metered: 'download requires a Download Pass or Expiry Postponement'. One-time Download Pass $2.00 (≤5 GB) or $2.00 + $0.40/GB above 5 GB. File Expiration Extension $5.00 buys 6 more hours, repeatable.

limits_note: 90-hour hard auto-delete on the free folder; 7-day default lifetime on paid folders; expiry purchased in 6-hour or 7-day increments
reliability_note: This is a TRANSFER service priced per upload-with-a-deadline, not storage. The '1000 GB for $6.99' line is a one-shot: 1 TB uploaded and held for 7 days. Annualised storage-equivalent is astronomically worse.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

evidence.proved: '50 GB upload $1.20 · 100 GB upload $1.60 · 500 GB upload $3.99 · 1000 × n GB upload $6.99 × n'; '1 Upload-GB lets you upload a 1 GB file and keep it available for 7 days'; 'One-time Download Pass $2.00 … ≤ 5 GB: $2.00 · > 5 GB: + $0.40/GB'; 'File Expiration Extension $5.00 … Each purchase adds 6 hours'
(free tier) — 'Web Folder Basic … No capacity limit. Auto-deleted 90 hours after upload'

price_per_tb_month: $6.99 per TB for a 7-day hold = $6.99 × (30.4/7) ≈ $30.36/TB/mo to hold 1 TB continuously. To hold 20 TB: ~$607/mo. Roughly 30× the 1fichier/Blomp floor. Dead end for storage; only rational as a paid download-enabler for a one-off link.
